steps.content: Sallie stumbles back into the dressing room on unsteady feet. Milly and Cassian are already there, waiting to discuss the next steps of their plan. Sallie's spirits are crushed, a bitter anger simmering in her heart.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: You shouldn't have done that. Drawing attention from Mr. E and the guests does us no good.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't blame Sallie, it was my fault. She had to step in because I messed up.
Milly scratches her cheek sheepishly. Despite her low mood, she tries to perk herself up to defend Sallie.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: And it's not all bad. At least Sallie won't be bullied anymore. Mr. E protects the ones who are popular.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: That's irrelevant. The problem is, once you're noticed, it becomes much harder to escape.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: In any case, you two can't afford any more complications. We need to get Sallie out of here as soon as possible. Let's move the plan up.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: There's been a mysterious fleet lurking nearby. I've hidden a small boat on the muster deck that can make short trips. Once we're out of here, we can try slipping into that group. Even if they're desert bandits...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: It won't work. I... I'm not going.
Sallie, who had been silent until now, speaks in a hoarse, exhausted voice. Her words shock the other two.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Think about it. The guests, all masked and covered up... what Mr. E said when he threatened you... all the unspeakable things they discuss...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I get it now... From the moment we were sold here, dancers like us were never meant to leave alive. That's why they can be so reckless... why they can speak so freely about those things.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: So don't waste your time. Staying here isn't so bad, is it? I've made a place for myself. I'll probably have a good life here. Haha, maybe Euphoria is about to have its second Jewel?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't say that!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Mr. E promised me before, that if my love came for me, he'd let me go. It's the same for you, Sallie! Once Theodore comes for you, Mr. E will let you leave.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Theodore? Come for me? Hehehe...
She leans her head against the wall, her body shaking with a low laughter. It goes on and on, until her hair falls over her face, leaving only a grin that keeps stretching.
Finally, she stops, tired from her laughter.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...There's no need to wait. He's already here.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...He's here?
Milly looks at Cassian, bewildered. Cassian is clearly taken aback, but when he sees Sallie's bowed head and hears the spite in her voice, his expression turns grave.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Shocking, right? Hehe, he's here. I saw him, and he saw me. He wasn't wearing a mask. Probably a new guest who doesn't know the rules. Haha. I wish you could've seen the look on his face...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: So ugly... I've never seen such a wretched face. Why do you think he looked that way? Because his former lover had sunk to this place? Or...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...because he knows how shameful it is, coming to a place like this to get his kicks? I wonder if he's scrambling to find a mask right now. Haha...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: He's not here to save me. He's here to have fun. Just like every other guest here. Like that masked bastard. They're all the same, scumbags!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Milly, you told me that if we found him, he would get me out of here. That we could be together. And I believed you.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Well, we've found him. What do you think he'll do? Profess his love for me with a straight face? Or just kill me to shut me up? A lowly dancer like me... must be a real embarrassment to him here, right?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Sallie...
Milly reaches to take her hands. They're as cold as ice.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: M-maybe there's some kind of misunderstanding? Should we find a chance to talk to him first?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You said he's here? I'll go find him right now! I'll set up a time for him to meet you.
Sallie laughs even harder. She stares at her new "friend."

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: A shadow casts over Labyrinth the vacuum from behind. A fuzzy furball tiptoes over, with apparent interest in the cleaning robot.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You heard it too, that day. For new rich families like his, the only way up is through connections and resources. Before they establish themselves, they won't let anything drag them down.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: And me? What can I possibly give him? I'm just a nobody stuck in the wings, drowning in debt, with no connections and a tattered reputation. The gap between us isn't something a love letter can bridge.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Roarrrr!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I was an idiot! Caught the fancy of a rich boy, lost my job, got loan sharks on my tail. He said he'd do everything to make me happy. Haha...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: And then? He vanished. Where was he when I ended up in this hellhole? Did he come here to save me?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: It's pathetic...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: It was so obvious, and I pretended not to see. I knew this world was rotten to the core, full of scheming and deceit, yet I still fell for his lies!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Why did I ever think he would come for me? Why would I think he's any different from all those beasts in human skin?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: And the most pathetic one of all is me. Milly, I actually let your stupid nonsense about true love get to me... I actually thought I could escape this place!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: And now? Reality slapped me right in the face.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: To hell with true love! To hell with light!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I thought I was rational. Realistic. But I still went along with your charade. Haha. What a joke.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Sallie!
As her tirade goes on, Sallie is on the verge of a breakdown. Milly rushes forward and throws her arms around her, holding her as she starts to sway.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You should still go see him. You're different from me. You and Theodore dated. You should know what kind of person he is better than anyone. You're so smart, you wouldn't be so easily fooled, right?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Go ask him. This is a rare chance to see him again. Even if it's just to see him for who he truly is.
Milly's attempts at comfort does nothing to ease the tension. Sallie slowly looks up and smiles mockingly.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I really envy you... Milly, you're even dumber than I am.
Milly is taken aback. Cassian realizes what Sallie's about to say and steps forward, trying to put himself between the girls.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Sallie.
Sallie ignores him. Shoving him aside, she keeps her eyes on Milly. She grabs Milly's wrists and pulls her close.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You never went to school, did you? Never saw the outside world, right? Well, let me tell you.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Did you know, Milly? Out there... in Eastside, in DisCity, love is the dumbest joke there is. All that talk about love and destiny... it's all lies. There's no such thing as love at first sight.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: That's not a fairy tale. It's a script designed to fool people, just like the act you put on onstage.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What is love, really? It's a hormonal impulse, a hit of dopamine, a fantasy painted out of loneliness. Tell you the right story, feed you the right lines, and you could mistake a devil for an angel.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: And they love girls like you who are desperate to be loved. So easy to trick. So easy to tame. And once you're tamed, they can use you for a long, long time.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You know how disgusting they are. Why else would you use that lip balm to protect yourself?
Milly tries to speak, but Sallie cuts her off harshly.
She can't stop. She won't stop. Her eyes are bloodshot, her grip tightening on Milly's wrists.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Tell me, Milly, has Mr. E ever told you that to love someone is to sacrifice everything for them? That they're the best thing in your life, that you should satisfy their every need, that their happiness is your happiness?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: That's what your boss told me when he made me serve the guests. That's what the masked bastard meant when he put a collar on me and told me to be his dog!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: This so-called love is just another way of getting you to pretty yourself up and serve yourself on a platter for someone else's amusement!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Even if your Chief shows up one day, do you really think he's here to take you away? Don't be so naive. Does anyone good ever come to this place?
steps.female_content: Even if your Chief shows up one day, do you really think she's here to take you away? Don't be so naive. Does anyone good ever come to this place?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: He's here for the show, for a new thrill. He's no different from Theodore, or any other masked scumbag on this ship. They're all just assholes, getting off on feeling like gods!
steps.female_content: She's here for the show, for a new thrill. She's no different from Theodore, or any other masked scumbag on this ship. They're all just assholes, getting off on feeling like gods!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: He's not like that!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: And how would you know? You don't even know if he's dead or alive!
steps.female_content: And how would you know? You don't even know if she's dead or alive!

steps.content: A deathly silence fills the room.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...It's pathetic. Pinning all your hopes on someone who probably doesn't even remember your name. You read a few newspaper stories and thought he's a hero. Idiot.
steps.female_content: ...It's pathetic. Pinning all your hopes on someone who probably doesn't even remember your name. You read a few newspaper stories and thought she's a hero. Idiot.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Those with money and power can make the press say black is white. In the papers, anyone can be a hero. You don't know him at all. All you want is a hero who can save you. As long as they say a few sweet words and beckon at you, you'd come running and wagging your tail, even if it were some petty bum.
steps.female_content: Those with money and power can make the press say black is white. In the papers, anyone can be a hero. You don't know her at all. All you want is a hero who can save you. As long as they say a few sweet words and beckon at you, you'd come running and wagging your tail, even if it were some petty bum.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What you love is nothing more than a fantasy. You love the fairy tale where you're saved, and the idea of yourself, waiting faithfully for your savior. The person you confide in, the person you adore... it's always been a delusion living in your head. And here you need to help me elope, just to prove your "true love conquers all" bullshit?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Stop being an idiot! When that man finds out and comes to you with a gun in his hand, will true love keep you alive? Does this rotten world even allow for such miracles?!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: No, it doesn't... Only you are stupid enough to believe that there are still good people in this goddamn world. To think that people like us still have hope. Only you refuse to see reality.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: We've fallen this far, and you think you can just plug your ears, shut your eyes, and find happiness by believing in love? Well, good for you. Go on, keep it up!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Only idiots can still smile here. Cling to your precious love and rot away on this ship, for the rest of your life!
Sallie's voice rings through the room. Milly hears every word. What is the expression on her face?
That face, usually bright with a radiant smile, has frozen like wax. Silent, Milly simply looks at Sallie, staring directly into her eyes.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Are those words... really for me?
Sallie doesn't answer. Maybe she has nothing left to say. Maybe in the next second, the Sinner before her will pull out that delicate dagger of hers and plunge it into Sallie's chest.
But Milly doesn't do that.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: If letting go of unnecessary love will keep you safe from suffering... then I want you to find happiness. I want you to never be hurt again.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But that's not for me.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I don't care.
She looks away and stands up. A knock comes at the door.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Milly, Mr. E wants to see you.
Milly walks past Cassian and straight out the door. She doesn't look back.

Sallie has said everything she needs to say. She leans against the wall, arms crossed. The fierce emotions drain away, leaving a vast, joyless emptiness. She can't even manage a laugh; only numb, quiet despair remains.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Elopement is off. I won't see Theodore. I don't need your help. It's not worth it.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Love isn't worth it at all...
Sallie's words hang in the air, a bitter punchline to a cruel farce, mocking herself and everything else.
The dressing room falls silent. Only Cassian and Sallie are left. The dim yellow light falls on the peeling paint, like hardened old wounds.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: You were taking your anger out on her. You know it.
Sallie doesn't respond. She stares at the floor, devoid of all emotion. After a long time, she speaks in a low voice.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Don't worry about me anymore. Don't take the risk.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: If you help someone escape... you'll get yourself killed. That man won't hesitate to do that.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Don't let Milly keep living in those romantic fairy tales of hers. Be realistic. Stay alive...

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: You think you're saying this for her sake?
He looks at Sallie.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: But now... you look like the one who gave up on yourself a long time ago.
Sallie let out a dry laugh. Give up? She was a fool to ever have hope in the first place.

Fleeing back to Eastside wouldn't save her. That's where she fell, where she was betrayed. Going back wouldn't change anything. The nightmare would just repeat itself. It's no different from here. The only reason she'd fantasize about escaping was because she was infected by delusions of love, because...
...she'd really believed... that where Theodore was, there might be hope.
Cassian sees her dry, bloodshot eyes, her colorless lips. This stubborn woman, like all the others trapped here for too long, has been hollowed out by despair, her spirit draining away.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: That escape route I mentioned wasn't prepared just for you. It was always my plan.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: The opportunity is rare, so I moved it up. A few modifications, and it could fit one more person.
He pauses, then speaks slowly.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: If you want to leave, come find me tomorrow. If not, then stay. Stay here for the rest of your life.
Cassian leaves. Cold light from the hallway filters through the crack in the door, thinning, until it too is swallowed by the darkness.
